name: blocks
title: Block clients
description: lib/blocks.ts: the blocks as typed clients over the Data API, acting as the caller, plus the notification types.
docs: Needs the blocks it wires: `npx better-supabase add organizations notifications search audit`, then `npx better-supabase gen` for `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts`. Add a block to `blockSet` after you install it. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/create-blocks.
